newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SBC hits new year high after Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: SBC hits new year high after Q1 results.

text.p: Swiss Bank Corp (SBC) registered shares touched a new year's high of 335.50, up 5.50, following release of its first-quarter results statement early on Friday. The shares then edged back to 335.00 by midmorning.
Its shares rose along with the general market. The Swiss Market Index (SMI) was up 8.0 points at 5,024 in midmorning.
SBC said that its first quarter 1997 net, after taxes and minorities, was above expectations and results were strong.
As usual, SBC provided no numbers with the report.
It also said it was confident that it would reach goals set for 1997, without specifying which goals.
Elaborating on the statement released on Friday, an SBC spokesman said the financial group last September had said it was projecting 1.7 billion Swiss francs in net profit for 1997.
SBC also has a medium-term ROE goal of 15 percent.
